name: ash-skills
description: Shared skills & commands used across my day-to-day workflows

vault_name.title: Obsidian vault name
vault_name.description: Vault name as shown in Obsidian's vault switcher, eg: Work

vault_path.title: Obsidian vault path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to the vault root, eg: /Users/<username>/Documents/Obsidian/Work

weekly_log_folder.title: Weekly log folder
weekly_log_folder.description: Folder for weekly logs, relative to the vault root, eg: Daily/Weekly Work Logs/{YEAR}. {YEAR} expands to the four-digit year

log_filename_format.title: Weekly log filename
log_filename_format.description: Filename for a week's log, dated by that week's Monday, eg: MM-DD-YY.md gives 03-16-26.md

weekly_log_template.title: Weekly log template note
weekly_log_template.description: Template note for a new week's log, relative to the vault root, eg: Templates/Weekly Work Log.md

review_context_files.title: Tech Lead Review: your goals notes
review_context_files.description: Optional. weekly-work-wrap can end with a Tech Lead Review: a short, critical read of your week with one thing to try next week. It measures the week against the notes you list here, so point it at notes describing your career goals, growth areas or role expectations. One or more note paths, vault-relative or absolute, eg: Career/Goals.md. Leave empty to turn the review off

company_name.title: Tech Lead Review: company
company_name.description: Optional, and only used when the Tech Lead Review is on. The review is written as a tech lead at this company, so the bar it holds your week to matches where you work, eg: Acme
